summary.text: Ryan Sample is the Green Party candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the incumbent is Jimmie Wilson Jr. (D).

paragraphs.text: Sample advanced from the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026.
He was also the Green Party candidate in the district in 2024, when Wilson won the general election and Sample received 3.4 percent of the vote.
